name: IEA 22MW Monopile
subtitle: Fixed-bottom · 34 m depth · 22 MW
description: IEA 22-280-RWT reference turbine on a monopile substructure in 34 m water depth. Rotor diameter 280 m, hub height ~169 m above MSL. Full offshore simulation: SeaState (JONSWAP, Hs=7.6 m, Tp=13 s), HydroDyn Morison strip theory (D=10 m), SubDyn flexible monopile. ROSCO controller (v2.10.1).
notes: Fixed-bottom offshore: CompSeaSt=1, CompHydro=1, CompSub=1, CompMooring=0, CompElast=1 (ElastoDyn). ElastoDyn platform DOFs all False (SubDyn handles platform dynamics). HydroDyn and SubDyn files sourced directly from IEA-22-280-RWT-main GitHub repo (already OpenFAST 4.x format). ROSCO 2.10.1 DISCON.IN bundled.
